Color Palette: "Autumn Transformation"

1. Fiery Crimson (#DC143C) - Captures the intense, vibrant reds of the leaves.
2. Burnt Orange (#CC5500) - Represents the warm, glowing oranges of autumn foliage.
3. Golden Amber (#FFBF00) - Adds a touch of radiant light and energy.
4. Deep Earth Brown (#4B3621) - Provides stability and grounding through rich, dark earth tones.
5. Muted Olive Green (#556B2F) - Offers a natural, transitional hue that bridges the fire and earth.
